candidates.description: This feature represents first-, second-, and third-person possessive pronouns and personal pronouns across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents demonstrative determiners and pronouns across multiple languages, primarily English, Portuguese, Spanish, and French.
This feature vector activates strongly on punctuation marks, particularly quotation marks often found at the beginning or end of quoted text and sentences.
Common coordinating and subordinating conjunctions and prepositions that frequently function as sentence or clause starters.
This feature activates for terms related to Christian religion, clergy, and ecclesiastical organization.
This vector activates on Roman numerals representing numbers.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "ant" or words containing the root "ant".
This vector represents colors and color-related terms across different languages and lexical variations.
This feature activates on words, names, and linguistic roots ending in the letters "al".
This vector represents the linguistic feature of capitalized alphabetical prefixes or abbreviations starting with the letter A.
